summary: Accepted. All 41 dated event additions cover the fresh audit's 22 affected people: 35 life attestations and 6 separately classified posthumous-reference reception events, plus exactly 16 associated active-date-hint updates. Source review confirms the corrected BC 199 s0170 ownership: s0150 identifies 韓王信 at 馬邑, s0151 continues the imperial campaign against 韓王信 at 銅鞮, and s0170's abbreviated 韓信 refers to that same remaining force at 東垣. Thus BC 199 belongs to p018 (Han Wang Xin), not p003 (the former Qi/Chu king Han Xin). p003 retains only its independently evidenced BC 202 and BC 201 events; p018 alone gains BC 199. The s0205 and s0311 decrees remain reception events and add no life-date hint.
